WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.standard_unit_cost AS unit_cost, p.valid_from AS pv_from, p.valid_to AS pv_to, p.vat_class
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South')
SELECT staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net_sum, sum(standard_cost) cost_sum,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(standard_cost - quantity*unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date NOT BETWEEN pv_from AND pv_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prod_ver_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 avg(net_amount/NULLIF(standard_cost,0)) ratio
FROM base GROUP BY 1

WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nonstaff_net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, sum(receipts) rpt_rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1),
rt AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net, sum(CASE WHEN sf.staff_purchase_flag THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) ret_staff FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.store_id, f.all_net, f.nonstaff_net, r.rpt_gross, r.rpt_ret, r.rpt_net, rt.ret_net, rt.ret_staff, f.rc, r.rpt_rc
FROM f LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN rt USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(f.standard_cost) sales_cost,
        sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount - f.standard_cost ELSE 0 END) margin_nonstaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) ref_net, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) ref_cost,
        sum(CASE WHEN NOT sf.staff_purchase_flag THEN r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned ELSE 0 END) ret_margin_nonstaff
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South' GROUP BY 1),
m AS (SELECT sold.sku, sold.sales_net - coalesce(ret.ref_net,0) - (sold.sales_cost - coalesce(ret.ref_cost,0)) AS margin_incl_staff,
        sold.margin_nonstaff - coalesce(ret.ret_margin_nonstaff,0) AS margin_excl_staff,
        sold.sales_net - sold.sales_cost AS margin_before_returns
      FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING(sku)),
cur AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) product_name, max(category) category, count(*) versions FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, cur.versions, round(margin_incl_staff,2) margin_incl_staff, rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_incl_staff DESC) r_incl,
 round(margin_excl_staff,2) margin_excl_staff, rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_excl_staff DESC) r_excl, round(margin_before_returns,2) m_before_ret, rank() OVER (ORDER BY margin_before_returns DESC) r_before
FROM m JOIN cur USING(sku) QUALIFY r_incl<=13 OR r_excl<=13 OR r_before<=13 ORDER BY r_incl

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net, sum(f.standard_cost) AS sales_cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South'
  GROUP BY p.sku),
returned AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) AS refund_cost
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region = 'South'
  GROUP BY p.sku),
names AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) AS product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku)
SELECT sold.sku, names.product_name,
       round(sold.sales_net - coalesce(returned.refund_net, 0) - (sold.sales_cost - coalesce(returned.refund_cost, 0)), 2) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM sold JOIN names USING (sku) LEFT JOIN returned USING (sku)
ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC LIMIT 10

WITH cur_south AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND region='South'),
sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount - f.standard_cost) AS m
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM cur_south) GROUP BY p.sku),
returned AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) AS m
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM cur_south) GROUP BY p.sku)
SELECT sold.sku, round(sold.m - coalesce(returned.m,0),2) AS gm_current_region FROM sold LEFT JOIN returned USING (sku) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
